conventions: Caster frame, Unity axes: x right, y up, z forward, metres, origin at the caster's feet when the move starts, z along the caster's facing. pos: the piece pivot at its key pose. fwd/up: the piece's own Unity forward (Blender local -Y) and up (Blender local +Z): rotation = casterRotation * LookRotation(fwd, up). scale: base local scale (Unity x, y, z). visible: [appear, vanish] seconds. offset_keys: [time, position added in the caster frame, easing into this key]. scale_keys: [time, multiplier on the base scale (Unity x, y, z), easing]. spin: degrees about axis (caster frame) through the piece pivot, applied before its base rotation. orbit: degrees about the caster-frame up axis through centre (positive turns +z toward +x), applied last. Easings: linear, out = 1-(1-x)^2, in = x^2, inout = smoothstep, outback = overshoot (c = 1.70158), step = jump at the key. Before the first key a channel holds its first value; after the last, its last. verb: the simple motion (fall, rise, sweep along a line, spread rings, spin/orbit, flicker/redraw, drift up and thin, lick/flare, ...). source: the kit FBX and object the piece is (paths under staging/blender/), or the stand-in it stands for.
